description: Assumed-modes cantilever (2 bending modes) as a scalar bond graph: the ring-down frequencies are the analytic Euler-Bernoulli eigenfrequencies, the settled tip deflection is the 2-mode modal sum F (4/k1 + 4/k2) = 0.9954 F L^3 / (3 E I).

checks.note: f1 = lambda1^2/(2 pi) sqrt(E I/(rho A L^4)), damped by zeta = 0.05 (sqrt(1 - zeta^2) = 0.9987)
f2 = lambda2^2/(2 pi) sqrt(E I/(rho A L^4))
static modal coordinate eta1 = phi1(L) F / k1
static modal coordinate eta2 = |phi2(L)| F / k2; the tip deflection 2 (eta1 + eta2) = 3.218763e-03 m is 0.9954 of Euler-Bernoulli F L^3/(3 E I) = 3.233624e-03 m
